purpose: Machine-readable inventory of every document that claims constitutional authority, and the explicit precedence state between them. This registry enumerates claims. It does not resolve them.
precedence_note: Contract 00 (.naya/contracts/00-NAYANET-CONSTITUTIONAL-CONTRACT-LAW.md) is RATIFIED by human direction 2026-09-26 and claims to be the constitutional law from which all subsequent contracts derive. The governance kernel and canonical source map still record .naya/codex/11-RUNTIME-CONSTITUTION.md as the current constitution. No machine or Naya may resolve this. Until a human ratifies precedence, the control-plane validator MUST fail closed.

roles.CANONICAL: The single governing constitution recorded by the governance kernel and canonical source map.
roles.COMPETING_UNRESOLVED: Asserts repository-wide constitutional authority that is not reconciled with CANONICAL. Blocks until a human ratifies precedence.
roles.SUBDOMAIN: Constitution scoped to a named domain, team, or channel. Does not claim repository-wide supremacy.
roles.DERIVATIVE_AMENDMENT: Amends an existing constitution under the repository's CONSTITUTIONAL-AMENDMENT-*.md convention.
roles.PROJECTION: An intelligence projection (Smart Note). Describes intelligence; is not an authority instrument.
roles.DESCRIPTIVE: Registry, index, audit, report, or specification that describes authority without holding it.
roles.SUPERSEDED: Explicitly retired or superseded by a human precedence decision.

authority_boundary: Role assignment is an inventory act, not a precedence decision. A human may reclassify any entry. Only precedence_status may be changed by an explicit human ratification record.
